Ridley Scott and Josh Brolin on The Dog Stars and What It Means to Remain Human After the End of the World

Ridley Scott and Josh Brolin discuss The Dog Stars, a gripping post-apocalyptic thriller about survival, trust, and humanity after the end of the world.
